[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided tips for improving throttle control, including smooth inputs, feeling the grip, throttle modulation, and using the correct gear.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided tips for improving braking points, including looking where to go, braking before the turn, gradual braking, and feeling the weight transfer.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant suggested additional tips for drifting practice, such as practicing regularly, starting slow, focusing on inputs, and learning from others.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant recommended specific exercises for throttle control, including Throttle Modulation Drill, Grip-Limit Exploration, Slow-Speed Drifting, and Throttle-Only Drifting.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant advised that high-performance tires can provide better grip, handling, and responsiveness, but may also make it more challenging to control the drift.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant suggested trying the exercises with the new tires to get familiar with their behavior and establish a baseline for skills.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant mentioned that new tires often require a break-in period and advised checking tire pressure according to the manufacturer's recommendations.
